about.text: A family of pressed, uncooked tommes from the Champsaur and the Alpes-Maritimes and Hautes-Alpes valleys. It includes a fresh tomme made by cooperatives and dairies in Queyras and Barcelonnette, and a farm tomme de garde.

sources.text: The Champsaur tomme section: pressed uncooked curd, the fresh tomme and the tomme de garde.
